Admission criterion: Adsorbent–dye kinetic system within the benchmark scope
Implementation / record: Modified montmorillonite/bentonite is the focus; mineral controls and neighboring composites are identified as boundary branches.

Admission criterion: At least three real positive-time measurements preceding the target
Implementation / record: A zero-time baseline is not counted; fitted/interpolated points are not treated as observations.

Admission criterion: One actual target observation with a recorded time-reading interval containing 120 min
Implementation / record: The original measured target and its recorded central time are retained; no synthetic 120-min point is inserted.
Direct removal % /100 is admissible; uptake q needs determinable C₀ and ρ=m/V, even if m and V are not individually available.

Admission criterion: Consistent conditions and physically feasible inventory normalization
Implementation / record: Ambiguous, conflicting or nonrecoverable uptake normalization is held; local reversals are retained, not corrected by fitting.

Admission criterion: DOI- and curve-level deduplication plus research-family linkage
Implementation / record: Related curves and publications are grouped before fitting/calibration/test assignment; model goodness of fit is not an admission filter.
